stats.fact: llama.cpp supports four split modes: none, layer (pipeline, default), row (deprecated), and tensor (experimental) for distributing a model across multiple GPUs.
Tensor parallel in llama.cpp requires flash attention and non-quantized KV cache (f32/f16/bf16); quantized KV cache is not implemented for tensor split.
llama.cpp tensor parallel is not implemented for MoE/hybrid architectures (Grok, DeepSeek2, Mistral4, etc.) and state-space models (Mamba, Mamba2).
vLLM recommends tensor_parallel_size = number of GPUs per node and pipeline_parallel_size = number of nodes for multi-node deployments.
For GPUs without NVLink interconnect (e.g. L40S), vLLM recommends pipeline parallelism over tensor parallelism for higher throughput and lower communication overhead.
vLLM uses Ray for multi-node inference and native Python multiprocessing for single-node inference by default.
llama.cpp NCCL support is selected at build time (-DGGML_CUDA_NCCL=ON, default) and NCCL is not automatically distributed with CUDA.
